heroIntro: Before the stage, there's the workshop. A 6 week series of sessions helping student speakers craft their stories, develop their ideas, and find their voice.
introParagraph1: Our workshop series ran in the lead-up to the flagship event, giving student speakers the tools and confidence to take the TEDx stage. Each session focused on a different dimension of the talk-building process.
introParagraph2: From finding your idea to crafting your narrative and delivering with impact — the workshops were a space for experimentation, feedback, and growth.
pullQuote: Every great talk starts long before the spotlight.
